author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam visits the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles and meets one of the star pieces of its collection: the Aries 1B filming model from 2001: A Space Odyssey! In the museum's Debbie Reynolds Conservation Studio, conservators tour Adam around the model and detail the five-year project to painstakingly restore the model to as close to its original filming condition as possible. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
